Prevention: Trim the bunds before crop sowing to prevent egg laying by pest.
Destroy the pupae by ploughing during the summer.
Collect and destroy (by burning) damaged buds to reduce the spread of the pest.
Plant border crop with red gram/cowpea/ black gram to increase natural enemies.
Grow trap crop of castor or chrysanthemum around the field for attracting the pest towards the trap crop.
Install 10 bird perches per acre from planting to encourage natural bird predators.
Monitoring: Set up light traps (1/acre from planting) and observe during 6 to 11 pm.
Set up sex pheromone traps (Heli lure) at 5/acre at the stage of 5-10 pod damage or 5 larvae per 10 plants.
Eggs are deposited individually on growing spikes.
Larvae bore into buds and flowers and feed on them by making holes.
Direct Control: Spray a solution of 250 ml of
Equivalents (LE) + 1 kg palm jaggery + 200 litre of water/ acre.
Spray in the evening hours with a hand sprayer.
Apply 2 applications with 10 day intervals. 3 sprays of
Bacillus thuringiensis at 2 g/l at 15 day intervals.
NSKE in 500 litres of water for 8 hours.
Filter and add 500 ml of teepol to spray 1
Neem oil at 30 ml in 1 litre of water at 15 day intervals.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
Quinolphos 2 ml/l of water at 15 day intervals
